WITH valid_token AS (
    SELECT t.assignment_id, t.trip_id, t.driver_id, t.action
    FROM action_tokens t
    JOIN driver_reservations r
      ON r.assignment_id = t.assignment_id
     AND r.trip_id = t.trip_id
     AND r.driver_id = t.driver_id
    WHERE t.token_hash = $1
      AND t.expires_at > NOW()
      AND t.used_at IS NULL
      AND t.action IN ('PRANO', 'REFUZO')
)
SELECT
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM valid_token) AS authorized,
    (SELECT row_to_json(v) FROM valid_token v) AS authorization;

parameters.query:
WITH claimed_operation AS (
  INSERT INTO dispatch_operations (
    operation_key, trip_id, assignment_id,
    driver_id, action, execution_id
  )
  SELECT
    t.assignment_id || ':decision',
    t.trip_id,
    t.assignment_id,
    t.driver_id,
    t.action,
    $2
  FROM action_tokens t
  JOIN driver_reservations r
    ON r.assignment_id = t.assignment_id
   AND r.trip_id = t.trip_id
   AND r.driver_id = t.driver_id
  WHERE t.token_hash = $1
    AND t.expires_at > NOW()
    AND t.used_at IS NULL
    AND t.action IN ('PRANO', 'REFUZO')
  ON CONFLICT (operation_key) DO UPDATE
  SET
    status = 'processing',
    execution_id = EXCLUDED.execution_id,
    completed_at = NULL
  WHERE dispatch_operations.status = 'failed'
    AND dispatch_operations.trip_id = EXCLUDED.trip_id
    AND dispatch_operations.assignment_id = EXCLUDED.assignment_id
    AND dispatch_operations.driver_id = EXCLUDED.driver_id
    AND dispatch_operations.action = EXCLUDED.action
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claimed_operation) AS claimed,
  (SELECT row_to_json(o)
   FROM claimed_operation o) AS operation;

WITH finished AS (
  UPDATE dispatch_operations
  SET status = 'completed',
      completed_at = NOW()
  WHERE operation_key = $1
    AND execution_id = $2
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND action = 'PRANO'
  RETURNING assignment_id, trip_id, driver_id
),
used_tokens AS (
  UPDATE action_tokens t
  SET used_at = NOW()
  FROM finished f
  WHERE t.assignment_id = f.assignment_id
    AND t.trip_id = f.trip_id
    AND t.driver_id = f.driver_id
    AND t.action IN ('PRANO', 'REFUZO')
    AND t.used_at IS NULL
  RETURNING t.token_hash
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finished) AS completed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM used_tokens) AS tokens_used;

WITH released_reservation AS (
  DELETE FROM driver_reservations r
  USING dispatch_operations o
  WHERE o.operation_key = $1
    AND o.execution_id = $2
    AND o.status = 'processing'
    AND o.action = 'REFUZO'
    AND r.driver_id = o.driver_id
    AND r.trip_id = o.trip_id
    AND r.assignment_id = o.assignment_id
  RETURNING r.driver_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS released_count
FROM released_reservation;

parameters.query:
WITH owned_operation AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM dispatch_operations o
  WHERE o.operation_key = $4
    AND o.execution_id = $5
    AND o.trip_id = $2
    AND o.action = 'REFUZO'
    AND o.status = 'processing'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dispatch_operations previous
      WHERE previous.trip_id = $2
        AND previous.driver_id = $1
        AND previous.action = 'REFUZO'
    )
),
existing_reservation AS (
  SELECT driver_id, trip_id, assignment_id
  FROM driver_reservations
  WHERE driver_id = $1
    AND trip_id = $2
    AND assignment_id = $3
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owned_operation)
),
new_reservation AS (
  INSERT INTO driver_reservations (
    driver_id, trip_id, assignment_id
  )
  SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $3::text
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owned_operation)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM existing_reservation
    )
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING driver_id, trip_id, assignment_id
),
chosen_reservation AS (
  SELECT * FROM new_reservation
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM existing_reservation
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM chosen_reservation
  ) AS claimed,
  (
    SELECT row_to_json(r)
    FROM chosen_reservation r
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS reservation;

parameters.query:
WITH eligible_reservation AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM driver_reservations r
  JOIN dispatch_operations o
    ON o.trip_id = r.trip_id
  WHERE r.assignment_id = $1
    AND r.trip_id = $2
    AND r.driver_id = $3
    AND o.operation_key = $4
    AND o.execution_id = $5
    AND o.action = 'REFUZO'
    AND o.status = 'processing'
),
generated_tokens AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    r.assignment_id,
    r.trip_id,
    r.driver_id,
    a.action,
    encode(gen_random_bytes(32), 'hex') AS token,
    NOW() + INTERVAL '30 minutes' AS expires_at
  FROM eligible_reservation r
  CROSS JOIN (
    VALUES ('PRANO'::text), ('REFUZO'::text)
  ) AS a(action)
),
stored_tokens AS (
  INSERT INTO action_tokens (
    token_hash,
    assignment_id,
    trip_id,
    driver_id,
    action,
    expires_at,
    used_at
  )
  SELECT
    encode(digest(token, 'sha256'), 'hex'),
    assignment_id,
    trip_id,
    driver_id,
    action,
    expires_at,
    NULL
  FROM generated_tokens
  RETURNING token_hash, action
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*)::integer AS tokens_created,
  MAX(g.token) FILTER (
    WHERE g.action = 'PRANO'
  ) AS accept_token,
  MAX(g.token) FILTER (
    WHERE g.action = 'REFUZO'
  ) AS refuse_token,
  MAX(g.expires_at) AS expires_at
FROM generated_tokens g
JOIN stored_tokens s
  ON s.token_hash = encode(digest(g.token, 'sha256'), 'hex')
 AND s.action = g.action;

nodes.name: Krijo tokenët e caktimit të ri

parameters.query:
WITH finished_operation AS (
  UPDATE dispatch_operations o
  SET
    status = 'completed',
    completed_at = NOW()
  WHERE o.operation_key = $1
    AND o.execution_id = $2
    AND o.action = 'REFUZO'
    AND o.status = 'processing'
    AND o.trip_id = $4
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM driver_reservations r
      WHERE r.assignment_id = $3
        AND r.trip_id = $4
        AND r.driver_id = $5
    )
    AND (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.action)
      FROM action_tokens t
      WHERE t.assignment_id = $3
        AND t.trip_id = $4
        AND t.driver_id = $5
        AND t.action IN ('PRANO', 'REFUZO')
        AND t.used_at IS NULL
        AND t.expires_at > NOW()
    ) = 2
  RETURNING
    o.assignment_id,
    o.trip_id,
    o.driver_id
),
invalidated_tokens AS (
  UPDATE action_tokens t
  SET used_at = NOW()
  FROM finished_operation o
  WHERE t.assignment_id = o.assignment_id
    AND t.trip_id = o.trip_id
    AND t.driver_id = o.driver_id
    AND t.used_at IS NULL
  RETURNING t.token_hash
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
    FROM finished_operation
  ) AS completed_count,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
    FROM invalidated_tokens
  ) AS invalidated_tokens_count;

    driver_id,

    token_hash,
    assignment_id,
    trip_id,
    driver_id,
    action,

    encode(digest(token, 'sha256'), 'hex'),
    assignment_id,
    trip_id,
    driver_id,
    'FILLIM',

)
